title: Comprehensive Office Cleaning & Toilet Sanitation Audit
description: Detailed daily/weekly inspection of restrooms, workstations, pantry, common areas, and waste disposal.

sections.title: 🚽 Restrooms & Toilets Sanitation
sections.description: Mandatory hygiene check for male, female, and accessible restrooms.

items.label: Toilet bowls & urinals sanitized, descaled, and stain-free
Hand soap dispensers refilled and fully functional
Hand paper towels stocked & hand dryers operating properly
Mirrors, sinks & faucets polished without water spots
Restroom floors mopped with disinfectant & dry (no slip hazard)
Sanitary bins emptied & fresh bags lined
Restrooms free of foul odor & air freshener active

sections.title: 🧼 Workstation & Desk Hygiene
sections.description: General office floor & desk sanitation check.

items.label: Desk surfaces wiped and dust-free
Personal desk waste bins emptied
Shared monitors, keyboards & mice disinfected
Under-desk power cables organized without tripping risk

sections.title: ☕ Pantry & Breakroom Sanitation
sections.description: Kitchenette, coffee machine, fridge, and eating area health check.

items.label: Refrigerator interior clean, no expired food items left
Microwaves, coffee machines & water dispensers cleaned & sanitized
Sink clear of dirty dishes; dish soap & sponge stocked
Pantry tables wiped clean with antibacterial spray

sections.title: 🧹 Common Area Floors & Waste Management
sections.description: Hallways, carpet vacuuming, glass doors, and central recycling.

items.label: Carpets vacuumed & hard floors mopped across all office zones
Main entry glass doors & partitions free of smudge/fingerprints
Central office waste & recycling stations emptied to main dumpster

title: Office Safety & Fire Preparedness Walkthrough
description: Inspection of fire extinguishers, exit signs, first aid kits, and emergency pathways.

sections.title: 🧯 Fire & Emergency Equipment
sections.description: Verify all life-safety devices are accessible and certified.

items.label: Fire extinguishers present, pressure gauge in GREEN zone, unblocked
Emergency exit doors & stairwells completely clear of boxes/obstacles
Illuminated EXIT signs functioning properly
First Aid kit fully stocked with non-expired bandages & antiseptics
